regions.full_page: Remembrance of The Passion 9 A.M. ZEAL for SOULS. "I am come to cast fire on the earth and what will I, but that it be kindled? (Luke XII 49) Motives (a) greatness of glory for immortal souls and to God. (b) Terrors of hell from which souls are saved. One's own reward ... "if any of you err from the truth, and one convert him .... he who causeth a sinner to be converted from the error of his way, shall save his soul from death, and shall cover a multitude of sins." St. Catherine of Sienna, 10 wonder! 0 wonder (waking out of ecstasy - sight of Heaven) How can I begin to describe the ineffab. the indescribable!"? St. Teresa after a vision of Heaven was ready to give her life a thousand times to save even one sinner for such glory.
